idea: Cross-multiply the given ratio to obtain 4m = 3a. This makes the numerator equal to 76 times the positive denominator.
proof:
have ha : (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt h₀.2)
  have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by
    exact_mod_cast h₀.1
  have ha_pos : (0 : ℝ) < a := by
    exact_mod_cast h₀.2
  have hrel : 4 * (m : ℝ) = 3 * (a : ℝ) := by
    have h := (div_eq_iff ha).mp h₁
    linarith
  have hden : (m : ℝ) + (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (add_pos hm_pos ha_pos)
  apply (div_eq_iff hden).2
  linarith
insight_proof:
have ha : (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt h₀.2)
  have h := (div_eq_iff ha).mp h₁
  linarith
